title: Roasted Cabbage With Parmesan, Walnuts and Anchovies

ingredients.name: Parmesan
ingredients.notes: finely grated, plus more for serving

steps.text: Heat oven to 450 degrees F. Quarter cabbage lengthwise through the core, remove cores and stem, then cut lengthwise into 1 1/2-inch-thick wedges.
Place wedges flat-side down on a rimmed sheet pan without overlapping if possible. Lightly drizzle with oil and season with salt.
Combine Parmesan, anchovies, garlic, thyme and pepper. Stir in 1/2 cup oil to make a loose paste, then massage it into each wedge and between the leaves.
Drizzle cabbage with a little more oil and roast until lightly browned, 25 to 30 minutes.
Sprinkle walnuts over cabbage and roast about 5 minutes more, until cabbage is tender and caramelized and nuts are golden.
Sprinkle with dill, more Parmesan and black pepper as desired. Serve immediately.
